hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: A Century of Bengaluru's Culinary Soul
hero.subtitle: Savour the authentic taste of tradition, where every Benne Dose tells a 100-year-old story.

about.title: Our Enduring Story at Central Tiffin Room
about.paragraph1: Central Tiffin Room (CTR), steeped deeply in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru, has been a culinary landmark since 1920. For over a century, we've delighted generations with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of timeless South Indian delicacies. At Central Tiffin Room, every dish is a cherished favorite, embodying the authentic flavors that have captivated patrons for over 100 years.
about.paragraph2: The rich legacy of Central Tiffin Room, initiated by the visionary Subramanyam brothers and continued by Mr. Sanjeev Poojari, Mr. Sandesh Poojari, and Ganesh S Poojari, epitomizes culinary mastery and tradition. We are 'The Emotion That Holds Old Bengaluru Together,' famously known for 'Bengaluru's Best Benne Dose,' a taste that has remained unchanged through the decades, nurtured by the boundless love of our dedicated patrons.
